context.transcript:
I'm reporting to you live from the University Science Museum.
They've recently opened up a fantastic new exhibit on the first floor.
From what I understand, the idea behind the exhibit came from Hassam Farahs.
Mr. Farahs develops exhibits at various institutions around the world.
I can see why he's in high demand.
This latest exhibit of his allows patrons to explore outer space.
It starts with the simulated thrill of rocket ship liftoff and continues as you experience traveling around the planets, watching the mysteries of outer space unfold around you.
context.transcript_translation:
我正在大学科学博物馆为您进行现场报道。
他们最近在一楼开了一个非常棒的新展览。
据我了解，这个展览的灵感来源于 Hassam Farahs。
Farahs 先生在世界各地的多个机构开发展览。
我能理解他为何如此抢手。
他最新的这个展览让参观者可以探索外太空。
它从模拟火箭发射的刺激感开始，然后随着您体验环绕行星的旅程，观看外太空神秘事物的展开。
